rows.note: This is the all-purpose rendering for a belt worn around the waist.

example.jyutping: ngo5 tiu4 jiu1 daai2 taai3 sung1 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a safety restraint such as a car seat belt.

example.english: Remember to fasten your seat belt when you get in the car.
example.jyutping: soeng5 ce1 gei3 dak1 kau3 on1 cyun4 daai2

rows.note: Use this for the belt in a machine that transfers motion or power.

example.english: The belt in the machine broke.
example.jyutping: bou6 gei1 ge3 pei4 daai2 dyun6 zo2

rows.note: Use this for a belt-like strip or zone such as a belt of trees or sand.

example.english: There are trees on both sides of this belt of land.
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 dei6 daai3 loeng5 pong4 dou1 hai6 syu6
